description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called GatewayQuickSetupSheet, facilitating quick setup and connection to a Gateway device via Bonjour discovery. It manages UI components, connection status, errors, and user interactions for establishing connectivity within an iOS app.

classes.name: GatewayQuickSetupSheet
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that provides an interface for discovering and connecting to a gateway device, with options for quick setup and error handling.

methods.name: bestCandidate
methods.description: Retrieves the first discovered gateway candidate based on the latest discovery data.
